resources.string: Keep the video frame fixed while the phone rotates. Choose an app using the Android system picker. Settings apply to the next recording. Experimental: Android 16 / One UI 8.5, SM-S948Q. Enable this module for System Framework, SystemUI, and Samsung Capture, then restart the phone.
Extend supported Android and Galaxy screen recorders. Turn off to use their standard behavior for new recordings.
Keep the initial video dimensions and rotate captured footage with the phone. Does not change the orientation of the phone itself.
Choose an app for Galaxy recording
Use the Android app picker before recording starts. Canceling the picker cancels the recording. Turn off to record the entire display as usual.
For app recordings, capture the initially selected main window instead of following other screens in the same app. Turn off to use Android task capture.
Allow hooks to be tried again. Restart the phone after resetting.
